description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Agreement-area polygons identify arrangements for developer installation of public sanitary-sewer facilities, including project, expiry and pro-rata-share fields. The native layer exposes polygon geometry and named attributes, including PROJ_NM, CONT_NM, EXP_DT, PRO_RATA_SHARE, AFN, SWLE_NUM. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for capacity planning studies. The county retains discretion over agreements; amounts, currency and outstanding liabilities are not independently established from field names. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
